name: campaign-map-original.png
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept edit. Asset: production-ready overview map for a cozy 2D Mediterranean seaside shop renovation game. Image 1 is the CURRENT DRAFT: retain the warm painterly turquoise-and-cream single-story shop near center-left, the small closed warehouse at upper-right, the honey stone paving, soft sunny lighting and four empty plots for future development. Image 2 is the approved material/color STYLE reference only. CORRECT THE GEOGRAPHY AND CUSTOMER ACCESS: this is a small privately owned retail courtyard ON A POPULATED BEACHFRONT, not an isolated rocky headland. Replace the rocky wave-battered coast, drop/cliff, enclosing front wall, stairs terminating at the sea, and dead-end jetty with a broad FLAT paved PEDESTRIAN PROMENADE that runs continuously LEFT TO RIGHT across the lower third of the picture and visibly continues beyond BOTH side edges. The shop's FRONT DOOR FACES THIS PROMENADE. A short, broad level paved entrance connects the promenade directly to the shop doorway with absolutely no wall, stairs, gates or building obstructing the route. The promenade connects to the neighboring village on the left: suggest a few distant white Mediterranean village rooftops and an adjoining lane, outside the owned plot, so visitors have a credible origin. Add just three tiny relaxed holiday pedestrians walking along the public promenade, clear simple silhouettes far smaller than buildings, no close-ups or faces. BELOW the promenade show a broad clean sandy public beach and a narrow band of CALM turquoise Mediterranean water along the very bottom edge, gentle small shore ripples. No rocks in surf, no cliffs, no wild waves, no isolated island, no dead-end landing, no dock. Reduce foreground sea so beach and customer route are plainly legible. Shop and warehouse remain fully inside frame. Keep four future plots bare and mostly empty, two behind/alongside the shop and two inside courtyard areas to the right and left, linked by internal paved paths. Small private boundary walls may border back or sides, never the shop's front/customer route. Keep believable scale and one coherent fixed elevated three-quarter camera, with the shop's front pointing toward the bottom of frame. Dimensional stylized illustration, rich tactile stone/wood/plaster, turquoise trim, cypresses and bougainvillea sparse at upper outer edges. START state: no operating bakery, no terrace tables, no fruit stalls, no restaurant, no second floor, no signs, no letters, no labels, no numbers, no pins, no UI, no watermark. The final image must immediately read as a beachfront shop people can reach on foot from a seaside village.
